text: N284303March 24, 2017CLA-2-61:OT:RR:NC:N3:359CATEGORY:	ClassificationTARIFF NO.: 6110.90.9090Mr. Hiromi AcunaChaser217 E. 157th StreetGardena, CA 90248	RE:	The tariff classification of a woman’s pullover from China  Dear Mr. Acuna:In your letter received by this office on  March 10, 2017, you requested a tariff classification ruling.  As requested, your sample sample will be returned.Style CW6717, is a woman’s pullover constructed from 100 percent linen slub knit fabric.  The outer surface of the garment’s fabric measures more than nine stitches per two centimeters in the direction the stitches were formed. The garment features a scoop front neckline, a high rear neckline, short hemmed sleeves, a self-fabric tie closure at the bottom of the front panel, and a loose fitting unfinished bottom.  The garment extends to below the waist.The applicable subheading for style CW6717 will be 6110.90.9090, Harmonized Tariff Schedule of the United States (HTSUS), which provides for Sweaters, pullovers, sweatshirts, waistcoats (vests) and similar articles, knitted or crocheted: Of other textile materials: Other: Other: Other: Other: Women’s or girls’.  The rate of duty will be 6 percent ad valorem.Duty rates are provided for your convenience and are subject to change.  The text of the most recent HTSUS and the accompanying duty rates are provided on the World Wide Web at https://hts.usitc.gov/current.This ruling is being issued under the provisions of Part 177 of the Customs Regulations (19 C.F.R. 177).A copy of the ruling or the control number indicated above should be provided with the entry documents filed at the time this merchandise is imported.  If you have any questions regarding the ruling, contact National Import Specialist Renée Orsat via email at renee.orsat@cbp.dhs.gov.Sincerely,Steven A. MackDirectorNational Commodity Specialist Division
